set_verbosity_debug: set the HuggingFace datasets library logging level to DEBUG to display all log information
set_verbosity_info: set the HuggingFace datasets library logging level to INFO to display most logging information
get_verbosity: get the current logging verbosity level for the HuggingFace datasets library root logger
get_logger: get a named logger instance for use in HuggingFace dataset builders
disable_propagation: disable log output propagation on the HuggingFace datasets library root logger
